title: Combined flotation-oxygen pressure leaching process for treatment of copper smelting slag with a high oxidation rate and its kinetic study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31230-31239
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02448J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zixuan Yang, Yuanlin Ma, Shuting Wang, Tingtao Bi
A process route combining flotation and oxygen pressure acid leaching (OPAL) was employed to comprehensively recover valuable metals (Cu, Mo, Fe, etc.) from copper smelting slag with a high oxidation degree.
